domains.name: Visitor Sign-in
domains.description: Visitors sign in at reception or a kiosk at any of the three offices and get a badge request started in under a minute.

stories.title: Sign in at kiosk
stories.text: As a Visitor, I want to sign in on a kiosk by entering my name, host and office and taking my photo, so that I can get my badge and meet my host without waiting.

stories.title: Check-in at reception
stories.text: As a Receptionist, I want to check in a visitor on their behalf at reception, so that visitors without kiosk access are handled without paperwork.

stories.title: Photo capture and privacy notice
stories.text: As a Visitor, I want to see how my photo and personal data are used before I submit, so that I know my data is handled in line with privacy rules.

stories.title: Office selection
stories.text: As a Receptionist, I want sign-in to be tied to the office (Lindenberg, Harbour Point or Eastgate) where I work, so that each visitor is recorded at the right building.

domains.name: Host Approval
domains.description: Notifies the host of an arrival and records approval by the host or a named delegate before the visitor passes reception.

stories.title: Notify host of arrival
stories.text: As a Host, I want to be notified when my visitor signs in, so that I can respond straight away and keep my visitor from waiting.

stories.title: Approve or decline visitor
stories.text: As a Host, I want to approve or decline a visitor request, so that nobody gets past reception without my consent.

stories.title: Name a delegate
stories.text: As a Host, I want to name a delegate who can approve in my place, so that visitors are still approved when I am unavailable.

stories.title: See approval status
stories.text: As a Receptionist, I want to see whether a visitor is approved, pending or declined, so that I only let approved visitors past reception.

domains.name: Security Check and Badges
domains.description: Watch-list check, badge printing with name, photo and host, and 18:00 expiry with reissue.

stories.title: Watch-list check
stories.text: As a Security desk officer, I want to check a visitor against the company watch list before a badge is issued, so that nobody who should not enter gets a badge.

stories.title: Print badge
stories.text: As a Receptionist, I want to print a badge showing the visitor's name, photo and host once the visitor is approved and cleared, so that I can send them to their host.

stories.title: Badge expiry
stories.text: As a Security desk officer, I want every badge to expire at 18:00 on the day of issue, so that old badges cannot be used to enter.

stories.title: Reissue badge after 18:00
stories.text: As a Security desk officer, I want to issue a new badge to a visitor who stays past 18:00, so that they can remain in the building legitimately.

domains.name: Sign-out and In-building List
domains.description: Sign-out and a live per-office list of who is in the building, kept reliable for evacuations.

stories.title: Sign out
stories.text: As a Visitor, I want to sign out when I leave, so that I am no longer counted as in the building.

stories.title: Live in-building list
stories.text: As a Facilities manager, I want a live list of visitors in each office, so that I can run the evacuation roll call.

stories.title: Handle missed sign-outs
stories.text: As a Facilities manager, I want visitors who forget to sign out not to appear as still present, so that the evacuation list stays reliable.

stories.title: Mark visitor as out at reception
stories.text: As a Receptionist, I want to sign out a visitor on their behalf, so that the list stays accurate when they forget.

domains.name: Data Retention
domains.description: Deletes visitor records and photos after 90 days in line with the data protection decision.

stories.title: Delete records after 90 days
stories.text: As a Facilities manager, I want visitor records and photos deleted automatically after 90 days, so that we comply with the data protection decision.

stories.title: Retention audit trail
stories.text: As a Facilities manager, I want a log of deletion runs without personal data, so that I can show the rule is being applied.

stories.title: Visit history within retention
stories.text: As a Facilities manager, I want to look up visits per office within the 90-day period, so that I can answer questions about recent visits.

tierWhy: The app has five domains and about 20 use cases, with kiosk and reception UIs, notifications, badge printing, scheduled jobs and likely integrations. That is more than one module with 8 screens is suited for.
